label: KODAK PROFESSIONAL PORTRA 160VC
source: Eastman Kodak Company technical data E-4040 (February 2009), PORTRA 160VC section: curves read from the PDF's vector paths (page 9); Print Grain Index from page 7

spectral_sensitivity.unit: log10 sensitivity (reciprocal exposure, erg/cm2, for density 0.2 above D-min)

print_grain_index.note: Kodak Print Grain Index (diffuse printing, 14 in viewing distance); RMS granularity not published

notes: Approximate digitization; not supplied or endorsed by Kodak Alaris / Eastman Kodak Company. Sensitometry x = (log H - Log H Ref) / log10(2), Log H Ref -1.14 lux-seconds read from the characteristic-curve chart; density is Status M including base, made monotone by running maximum. Spectral sensitivity kept only where the curve is drawn on the chart; wavelengths where a curve is not drawn are omitted, so a channel's wavelength list can be non-contiguous. Individual dye curves not published; dye_density holds only the published midscale neutral and minimum density curves. Characteristic curves (E4040B): Exposure Daylight, Densitometry Status M, Log H Ref -1.14 (no process line); density axis calibrated from the drawn tick marks (1.0 and 3.0), which put 0.0 on the drawn frame bottom. Spectral sensitivity (E4040F, the same artwork code as the 160NC page): Daylight, effective exposure 1/25 s, Status M, density 0.2 above D-min; log-sensitivity axis 0.0 to 4.0. Spectral dye density (E4040J): typical densities for a midscale neutral subject and D-min (no process line). Print Grain Index table as published on page 7 (160VC row): 'Less than 25' entries are kept as 'less than 25' (25 is the visual threshold), no print sizes in cm are published, 4 x 5 in magnifications listed as 1.2X, 2.1X, 4.2X. The two supplied PDFs (kodak-portra160nc-vc.pdf and kodak-portra-nc-vc-800.pdf) are the same E-4040 publication with identical drawings; kodak-portra160nc-vc.pdf was read. The MTF chart (E4040O, Exposure Daylight, Process C-41) is not digitized.

scan.note: fitted to 76 Lomography community scans (lomography.com/films/871934722-kodak-portra-160vc-35mm/photos, recent, pages 1-2, double exposures removed, 2026-11-12); colours of real scans, not manufacturer data
